ingredients.name: almond extract, or 1/2 cup chopped almonds instead

steps.instruction: Cream 3/4 cup of butter or margarine with 1 cup of white granulated sugar.
Beat in 1 1/2 tablespoons of oil and 1/3 cup of milk.
Blend in 2 eggs, one at a time.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 1/2 teaspoon of almond extract.
steps.spoken: Mix in 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 1/2 teaspoon of almond extract. You can use 1/2 cup of chopped almonds instead of the almond extract.

steps.instruction: Mix in 6 tablespoons of cocoa powder and 3/4 cup of sifted flour.
Spread the batter into a greased 10 1/2 by 7-inch cake pan.
Bake for 28 minutes, until a toothpick comes out with only moist crumbs.
steps.spoken: Bake for 28 to 30 minutes. A toothpick pushed into the center should come out with no more than moist crumbs.
